notes.title: Patch to version 1.1
notes.content:
Patch notes for version 1.1

 Fixed inventory issues. Some players reported collecting items before starting a quest prevented them from finishing the quest as the items no longer existed. Improved inventory system to correct this.
 Fixed issue where controller could lockout controls when going between menu systems, requiring a restart of the game. At most the gamepad/controller may need to be reconnected.
 Fixed collision issues near several water surfaces where some players reported getting stuck in the water unable to swim/walk out.
 Fixed collision issues that could force the player under the level near the shoreline.
 Revised settings menu, v-sync is now enabled by default and the settings menu will correctly show saved settings.
Improved saving of settings and menu correction should improve performance for some players.
 Various grammatical corrections across various characters.
 Added dialogue and quest for in-game character (Bella) who will suggest how to open the gate to the lighthouse.
 Added dialogue for in-game character (Marty) who has some insight into the island.


Thanks again for checking out Tchunk! Any feedback is appreciated. Thanks!

notes.title: Tchunk is now available!
notes.content:
As of today Tchunk is available! I'm so glad to finally be able to put this out and share it with the world. I look forward to any feedback anyone has. 


Some items you can expect!

A choice- talk to the locals to find out more- or find where your adventure takes you.
A calming environment awaiting exploration! 
The possibility of being granted the power to control the time of day.



Thanks & Happy Exploring!
